description:
The streak counts calendar-day adjacency, so a planned rest day breaks it. It punishes following the program, which is the opposite of what a streak is for.

Score it against the program's actual cadence instead. The History screen already has an honest-presentation rule for this area: when the streak is 0 but something was trained, it shows "Nd ago / Last trained" rather than "0d / Current streak". Whatever replaces the calculation has to keep that honesty.
title: Fix the streak to track rotation cadence
